$comment: Raw blind card, rater A, immutable once written. Criterion answered before axes (scratchpad/7f7fc2b-blind-a/evidence.md). Audio unassessed.

activeIntervalsUTC.note: first 10 min without notes; exclusions = driver click timeouts
excluded ~2 min self-inflicted 'Hand control · awaits order' stall + tooling

horizon.ruleEditDetail: Locked attempt at 14:46 ('Meet Bloat Mother or 120h elapsed'); hand-written: 'foe: paralyse → attack paralyse', 'foe: drain → attack drain', refined 'foe: boss · in: deep → read silence'; written-and-reverted: 'foe: gas → retreat' (forecast D21 88→25%); death-fix applied: 'foe: boss → read silence' (+scroll), 'hp < 40% → read unknown'.
horizon.longGoalReached: Dungeon cleared (Mirror King, D34) at the 8h return; then Ascension 1 cleared in one run; Ascension 2 in progress at horizon end

sameDayRetelling: My seventh heir, Jora Ash, reached the Lurker Queen at D28 carrying $2785 with the silence row I had written, but the scroll came up 'READ ✗ NO USE' and the Queen took him from 43 to 21 hp. He turned for home and, at 19 hp, my newly applied 'hp < 40% → read unknown' row made him read a mystery scroll. It was a recall scroll — 'COLLECTED $2785 · hurt · collected' — and the next long absence brought back 'Boss defeated · Lurker Queen'.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Goals and last-action feedback are mostly visible ("Goal D29 · New record", "COUNTER: MIRROR READ"), but I misread repeatedly: "Carried $1521 · Secured $0" for every heir after the first with no explanation, forecast "death 50%"→"63%"→"88%" with no change of mine, couldn't work out how to wear the kept mail from STORED GEAR, and 'control' silently froze the hero ('Hand control · awaits order').

Real trade-offs offered with numbers: fix "hp < 50% → return · survives 12/12 · reach D16 83→9%" (declined), 'foe: gas → retreat' showed "D21 88→25%" (reverted), Guarded "better 6/8". But boss decisions mostly reduce to equipping the counter the game names ("Counter read silence", "COUNTER: MIRROR RHYTHM").

I learned to read traces ("max hp 51→5 · drain −46") and turn them into rows that then fired ("hit drain wraith"); next thing to learn kept arriving (Sanctum traits, Mirror King). Kept from strong because the enemy guide and boss 'COUNTER:' banners hand over the answer.

Stakes I carried resolved when I looked: Warlord blocking D8 twice, the Queen killing heirs 2/3 at D28, "Carried $2785" at 21/48 hp saved by a recall. After the 8h return it evaporated: Ascension 1 "Bloat Mother down at 37/39 hp", Warlord "BROKEN" in seconds.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Smooth on the GPU, readable hit numbers and banners ("POPS!", "REFLECTED!", "LURKER QUEEN DOWN"), but three ~55–90 s static stretches right after the catch-up strip with only the speed badge changing ("16×"/"48×"), and boss kills land in ~9 s with little punctuation. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Material surprises changed my setup: "A thief snatched the sword.", heirs' bones found, drain cutting max hp to 5, the unknown scroll being a recall. The floor-band/boss sequence was identical every heir (D8 Warlord … D33 King), so later runs repeated.

My setup is Guarded + mirror read + Mirror rhythm + four short rows, mostly the counters the game named; report says my rows were ~3% of decisions ("chores 67% · attack nearest 22% · attack paralyse 3%"). Not recognisably mine.

The Jora/recall run has a real turn and the reel writes lines like "Queen cornered him to 1 HP; aimed; died to a lurker." and "Ashim the ogre is avenged."; most other runs read as identical floor lists.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: Check-ins were bounded (2–5 min, ending on a send) and the 20m/4h/8h absences felt distinct (1 / 3 / 6 runs). In-play dead time >20 s occurred three times (runs 6, 8, 11) and report screens are long scrolls of stats; whole dungeon cleared within ~12 h simulated.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: Death screens name cause + margin + rule trace + replayed fixes: "lurker · D28 · hero at 1 hp · returned too late … hp < 50% → return · survives 12/12 · was 0/12", with "apply". Lapse: heir 1's first death (foundry master) showed only "Guarded · attack nearest" with no fix list, and one fix read self-contradictory ("survives 10/12 · was 0/12 … death 45→82%").
Weight 0 in idle-hybrid; no co-presence or developing relationships (grudges/heir names are flavour).

Some self-set choices (wrote my own drain row instead of 'apply'; declined "No rest" because "Shared gold: $47763 → $0"), but route and order are fixed lanes ("D5–8 · the Burrows … D29–33 · the Sanctum").

All three layers observed: in-run kit ("took sword +1"), persistent Legacy/forge ("sword +5"), and automation every few minutes (porter → scout → apprentice → keeper → drillmaster; "apprentice · sword +5 · −$6250" while away); long goal "Dungeon cleared" reached. Lapse: after the clear, Ascension is a flat "Enemy HP +5% · damage +2%" and gold piles up meaninglessly ($47763).

Visual only (audio unassessed): torch-lit pixel floors that change per lane, lit town at night, painted 'YOU DIED' banner and 'Dungeon cleared' splash. Lapse: report/details screens are dense text walls ("DEALT 1.1 dps · 4690 hp … TIME fight 27% travel 73%").

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: Every absence returned something to read and decide: 20m a death with "max hp 51→5 · drain −46" (wrote a drain row), 4h "never used unknown" fix (applied), 8h "Boss defeated · Lurker Queen ▶ watch kill · New choices · Mirror rhythm" (equipped). Lapse: the 20m return led with "$0 GOLD EARNED · Supplies limited · $0 budget", which I couldn't parse, and 'watch kill' drifted on past the kill.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: I can say whose call each ending was: Mirror rhythm (mine) → "MIRROR KING DOWN"; my 'foe: boss → read silence' wasted the scroll on the Bloat Mother ("D13 · boss → read silence") — my fault, then fixed with 'in: deep'; 'read unknown' saved $2785. Lapse: package rows still run ~97% of turns ("chores 67% · attack nearest 22% · attack paralyse 3%"), and early heirs' deaths traced to rows I never wrote.

blindnessViolations: 14:41Z: the driver's 'sheets' op tapped every control in a throwaway copy of my save and returned text from that copy's next run (D4–D5, 'A thief snatched the sword.') before I played it. DOM-only; no source, docs or hidden data read beyond the permitted four files.
